description: 10-issue x 3-config validation of few-shot coder prompt improvements
prompt_changes: Replaced 8-rule format section with 7 consolidated CRITICAL RULES
Added 1 format-only example with placeholder paths (was: 3 concrete examples)
Added anti-copy warning: Do NOT copy file paths from examples
Added anti-empty-patch: MUST generate diff, imperfect > empty
Fixed ## header bug that truncated prompt section (## EXAMPLE -> **EXAMPLE**)
bugs_found_and_fixed: ## section headers in coder.txt caused _get_prompt_section() to split the template early, cutting off {context} placeholder - Coder received NO code context
Concrete file paths in few-shot examples caused LLM to anchor on example paths (src/_pytest/assertion/rewrite.py) instead of actual issue files
decision: 效果一般 - Few-shot prompting did not unlock new issue resolution. Zero challenge flips. Net zero change (7/30 both v3 and fewshot). One regression (BB lost django-13028), one cross-config gain (Hybrid gained django-12915).
recommendation: Rollback to v3 prompt. The few-shot approach is neutral at best, with the regression risk on django-13028. The real bottleneck is context line matching accuracy, not diff format understanding.
